cache.__doc__: v7.2 M1/M3 — Prompt caching policy. ttl='1h' requires ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1 env var. v7.3-M4: read_cache 관측 훅 제거됨 (Claude Code v2026 내장 캐시 사용). 하위 read_cache 섹션은 레거시 설정이며 동작하지 않는다.

execution.__doc__: v7.2 Phase B/C — Parallelism, isolation, and autonomous loop flags. Defaults keep V7 serial behavior. parallelism=true enables M4 (reviewer+verifier parallel) and M5 (research 3-perspective parallel). isolation='worktree' enables M6. background_post_steps=true enables M7. ralph_sentinel=true enables M12 (ScheduleWakeup-based autonomous ralph loop).

mcp.__doc__: v7.2 M11 — MCP server integration flags. context7 powers vela-researcher's version-accurate docs lookup for external libraries.

models.__doc__: v7.2 M2 — Per-role model routing. PM reads `recommended_model` from `vela-engine state` and passes it as the `model` field to Agent() spawns. 'default' applies when a step has no explicit mapping. Valid values: 'sonnet' | 'opus' | 'haiku' | 'inherit'.
